Entry 97: Nicks signed March 14 (1 year, up to $5M, $4.5M guaranteed); Hawkins's offer sheet signed March 13 and Cincinnati declined to match March 18 (4 years, $15.6M, $8M guaranteed); Edelman returned to New England.
Entry 98: Te'o-Nesheim signed in the replay (3 years, up to $13.5M, $6.0M guaranteed; 2014 cap $3.0M).
